Api Vishal Patil, Ndps Cell Nashik City, present.
Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned App for Respondent/State.

2.  This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.592 of 2022 registered with Ambad Police Station, Nashik for the offenses under Section 328, 188, 272 & 273 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC', for short) and Sections 26(2)(i), 27, 30(2)(a), 26(2)(iv), 3(1)(zz)(iv), 27(3)(e) and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. Admittedly the Applicant is protected by this Court's order dated 26.10.2023, for last about 2 years wherein it is already recorded that the Applicant was named by co-accused who was found in Mukesh Rathaur S/O Shivram Rathaur vs The Senior Police Inspector And Anr on 28 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100568467/
1 possession of contraband articles being Gutakha Pan Masala.
4.

entities.text: Shivram Rathaur vs The Senior Police Inspector And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the Applicant submits that his name was 57 ABA-2984-2023.doc involved only because of vehicle/truck carrying contraband article was earlier owned by the Applicant.
It is contended that the Applicant had sold it prior to the date of FIR.

5. Learned APP for the Respondent/State on instructions of Investigating Officer (who is present in the Court), submits that investigation is complete and charge-sheet is already filed and the Applicant is not shown as co-accused.

6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances and considering that the Applicant was protected so far under order of this Court and further considering that the issue regarding applicability of Section 328 of IPC to Gutakha is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, case for grant of pre-arrest bail is made out.
7. The application is allowed in terms of the order dated 26.10.2023 and disposed of.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
